variants.name: The Hitman and the Seer
variants.tooltip:
Aphelios wields 5 Lunari Weapons made by his sister, Alune. He has access to two at a time: one main-hand and one off-hand. Each weapon has a unique Attack and Ability [@spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:Hotkey@]. Attacks and Abilities consume a weapon's ammo. When out of ammo, Aphelios discards the weapon and Alune summons the next one.

Aphelios unlocks his weapon's Ability [@spell.ApheliosCalibrumQ:Hotkey@] at level 2 and his Ultimate at level 6. Instead of powering up his Abilities, Aphelios' rank-ups grant him permanent stats.

variants.tooltip:
Rammus enters a defensive formation for @BuffDuration@ seconds, gaining @BonusArmorTooltip@ Armor and @BonusMRTooltip@ Magic Resist and dealing @ReturnDamageCalc@ magic damage to enemies that Attack him.

Recast: Rammus ends this Ability early.

variants.name: Unseen Predator
variants.tooltipExtended:
{{Spell_RengarPassive_Tooltip}}
Rengar loses all Ferocity after being out of combat for @InCombatTimer@ seconds.
Rengar gains extra Attack Damage for killing Kha'Zix.

variants.name: Absolution
variants.tooltipExtended:
{{Spell_SennaPassive_Tooltip}}

Senna can only siphon Mist from an individual champion once every @DebuffDuration@ seconds.
Souls are less likely to spawn from minions Senna kills. Souls always spawn from large minions Senna doesn't kill, champions, and large jungle monsters.
Senna does not gain Attack Damage on level up.

variants.name: Living Vengeance
variants.tooltip:
When Varus kills an enemy, he gains @MinionAS@ Attack Speed, @MinionAD@ Attack Damage, and @MinionAP@ Ability Power for @ASDuration@ seconds.

Champion takedowns grant @ChampionAS@ Attack Speed that can bypass the Attack Speed cap, @ChampionAD@ Attack Damage, and @ChampionAP@ Ability Power instead.

variants.name: Cultivation of War
variants.tooltip:
Zaahen gains a stack of Determination when he hits an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability (max @MaxStacks@). He gains @PercentBonusADCalc@ increased Attack Damage per stack.

When filled with Determination, Zaahen doubles the granted Attack Damage, and if he would die, he instead enters Stasis for @ReviveDuration@ seconds then revives with @RevivePercentCalc@ of his max Health.

Zaahen's revive has a @ReviveCooldownCalc@ second Cooldown.
